cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you bin our ferry ticket, remember the overtime we worked for that weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We missed the ferry. I hate being reminded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We stayed anyway. That was the first time we chose each other over a refund.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the hotel receipt, then. That part was lovely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you write that on the envelope? In your handwriting, so it isn't just me saying it mattered.

mechanism: A teaches its partner how to evaluate a shared trip, correcting failure accounting into written recognition of the meaningful choice to stay together.
confusable: Not forcing a happy recollection of everything: A accepts a better memento but asks B to affirm why it mattered.
comparison: Garden routine versus deliberate weekend after missed ferry.
seedUse: D81 overtime/ferry/hotel/envelope; S05 grades memory-selection and asks a complete caption.
